# RGAA accessibility review

Audit the requested Twig templates and markup for RGAA 4.1 issues, including image alternatives, heading hierarchy, ARIA, contrast, form labels, keyboard focus, accessible tables, and link names.

Do not modify code. Report prioritized issues with file/line, impact, and a corrective example.
